an4.58:1.1: Then the householder Anāthapiṇḍika approached the Blessed One…. The Blessed One then said to him:
an4.58:2.1: “Householder, a noble disciple who gives food gives the recipients four things.
an4.58:2.3: He gives life, beauty, happiness, and strength.
an4.58:2.4: (1) Having given life, he partakes of life, whether celestial or human.
an4.58:2.5: (2) Having given beauty, he partakes of beauty, whether celestial or human. (3) Having given happiness, he partakes of happiness, whether celestial or human. (4) Having given strength, he partakes of strength, whether celestial or human.
an4.58:2.6: Householder, a noble disciple who gives food gives the recipients these four things.”
an4.58:3.1: One who respectfully gives timely food
an4.58:3.2: to those self-controlled ones who eat what others give,
an4.58:4.1: The man who gives life and beauty,
an4.58:4.3: will obtain long life and fame
